# Who Is the Greatest International Soccer Striker of All Time?

The greatest-striker debate is usually shaped by reputation and nostalgia. This project approaches it differently. Using international goal data, it evaluates the strongest candidates through a structured analysis of scoring volume, scoring style, efficiency, and career durability.

[Read the analysis](analysis.html){.btn .btn-light .btn-lg}
:::

::: {.grid .g-4 .mt-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Why this question matters

The central question is not simply who scored the most goals. It is who built the strongest all-around case across the full scope of an international career.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### What the site examines

The analysis looks at raw totals, open-play production, efficiency over active years, and the broader structure of a striker's career. The goal is to move the debate from opinion toward evidence.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note}
This site is designed to feel like a published analytics feature: concise, confident, and grounded in the data.
:::
